summary: Preserve Duplex half-open behavior and the allowHalfOpen option/property.

target.notes: When false, readable-side end automatically ends the writable side; default true keeps the writable side open. Runtime changes must occur before the readable 'end' event to affect that transition.

caveats: Do not conflate TCP half-close details with the generic Duplex state machine.

tests.name: false links readable end to writable end
tests.expected_behavior: writable side is automatically ended after readable end and finish is emitted
